pitch.logline: Two estranged sisters push a dead station wagon across the desert to deliver their mother's last letter.
pitch.why:
I spent my summers in a motel my aunt ran at the edge of a dry lake. Nobody stayed more than a night, and everybody told her more than they meant to.

Salt Flat is that place and those people: one road, one motel, two sisters who have run out of ways to avoid each other. I wrote it for what a small crew can shoot well in twelve days.

audience.primary: Women over thirty who go to independent films with a sister, a mother or a friend.
audience.secondary: Anyone who has driven a long way with family and not talked about why.
audience.notes: A festival first, then the podcasts and newsletters this audience already trusts.

sections.heading: The story
sections.body:
Lena wants the letter burned. June wants it read. Their mother asked for it to be left under a stone on the salt flats, and the only way there is together.

By the time they reach the stone, the car is the least broken thing they have fixed.

design.notes: Worked out from the look book: a dusk ground, a pale salt card, a dusty rose accent and the blue of the sky over the flats. Typewriter titles, plain text, handwriting on aged paper.

slides.headline: Twelve days, one unit, one stretch of desert.
slides.closing: Every set is within twenty minutes of the motel, so no day is lost to a company move.

slides.headline: Everyone who makes the film shares in it.
slides.body: Cast and crew work at scale and hold points in a shared pool. Investors are paid from the first dollar the film earns.
slides.closing: The same terms for every investor.

cards.title: Invest
cards.body: You take 60 cents of every dollar the film earns until you have 120% back, then half of everything after.

cards.title: Give
cards.body: A grant or a gift through the film's fiscal sponsor. It is never repaid, and it lowers what investors put in.
cards.footnote: The fiscal sponsor keeps 7% of each gift.

cards.title: Lend
cards.body: A location, a truck, a week of your time. Help in kind comes off the budget as cash does.

slides.headline: What investors fund,
slides.body: Three cases, from a quiet release to a good one. In the low case investors do not get their money back.
